/reference/api-keys.md): Which 'API key' is which in MCPJam, and the one you need to call the MCPJam API.\n- [Pay for one local ev
al iteration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/pay-for-one-local-eval-iteration.md): Collect the declared prompt fe
e and reserve one iteration atomically before execution. Retries with the same identity reuse the receipt; changed requests confli
ct. Uploads claim the payment without charging again.\n- [Preview draft judge grading on one recorded iteration](https://docs.mcpj
am.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-draft-judge-grading-on-one-recorded-iteration.md): Uses model budget and complete recorded
evidence without changing the run verdict. Supply rubric.instructions, optional structured criteria, or null for objective-only gr
ading. Continue with the unchanged rubric and returned cursor, sourceHash and reservationId. Completed page retries return cached…
\n- [Create an eval run (async)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-run-async.md): Creates a suite run
from an existing `suiteId` (rerun) and/or inline `tests`, then **detaches execution and responds `202` immediately** with the `ru
nId`. Validation and quota errors surface on this request; poll `GET /eval-runs/{runId}` for progress. The run appears live in the
hosted UI Runs tab,…\n- [Get run status](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-run-status.md): Run status, result,
and summary. Poll until `status` is terminal (`completed`, `failed`, `cancelled` or `timed_out`). `grading` is not terminal (every
trial has finished and the run is held for its gating judge, with `result` still `pending`), so keep polling.\n- [Get a run's dec
ision summary](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-a-runs-decision-summary.md): The canonical, versioned run decis
ion contract: the verdict and where it came from, the counts with the population they count, the run's own verdict decision when i
t has one, and one page of per-trial diagnostics carrying the user-value chain, the first failed stage, the failure category, evid
ence s…\n- [Compare a run against a baseline](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/compare-a-run-against-a-baseline.md)
: Compare this run against a baseline run: per-case status (`regressed`, `fixed`, `new_case`, `removed_case`, `changed`), per-scor
er pass-rate and mean deltas from the evaluation contract, and whether the evaluation config changed. Omit `baseRunId` to compare
against the nearest earlier **completed**…\n- [List run iterations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-run-itera
tions.md): Per-iteration results: actual tool calls, structured token usage, and latency. Cursor-paginated.\n- [Get an iteration t
race](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-iteration-trace.md): Full trace envelope for one iteration: conversat
ion messages, expected-vs-actual tool call analysis, and spans. The shape is rich and may evolve. Treat it as an open document. Re
turns `404` with `details.reason: \"TRACE_NOT_AVAILABLE\"` when the iteration finished without a stored trace.\n- [Get an iteratio
n's step results](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-iterations-step-results.md): One row per authored test st
ep, in order, with `status` (`ok`/`fail`/`skipped`/`pending`), a `reason`, and any `evidence` (screenshots, replay-video offset, w
idget tool calls). The fastest way to see which step failed and why. Unlike `/trace`, a missing trace is not a `404`: step verdict
s still retu…\n- [Cancel a run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/cancel-a-run.md): Request cancellation of an in-fl
ight run; marks the run and its pending/running iterations `cancelled`. A run held in `grading` for its gating judge CAN be cancel
led: it lands `cancelled` with no verdict, which is the honest outcome for a run nobody waited out. A no-op success when the run i
s alread…\n- [Preview a failed-cases rerun](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-a-failed-cases-rerun.md): What
`POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/rerun` with `scope: \"failed_cases\"` would execute, before anything spends. The pl
atform selects every case with a trial that is not completed and passed; cancelled and skipped trials do not count. `reasons` and
`excluded` count trials; `selectedCase…\n- [Rerun a run's failed cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/rerun-a-ru
ns-failed-cases.md): Replay a finished run's frozen snapshot narrowed to the cases that did not pass: every case with a trial that
is not completed and passed (cancelled and skipped trials do not count). The platform selects the cases. See the rerun preview. T
he new run records `rerunOfRunId` and `rerunScope`, and becau…\n- [List a suite's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval
-runs/list-a-suites-runs.md): Recent runs for a suite, newest first.\n- [List a suite's per-run stage analytics](https://docs.mcpj
am.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-per-run-stage-analytics.md): One materialized stage-analytics document per RUN, newes
t completion first: where trials fell out of the six-stage user-value chain (connection, discovery, selection, tool call, response
, user value), overall and sliced marginally by intent, model and host.\n- [Get one run's stage analytics](https://docs.mcpjam.com
/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-runs-stage-analytics.md): ONE run's materialized stage-analytics document: where its trials fell
out of the six-stage user-value chain (connection, discovery, selection, tool call, response, user value), overall and sliced marg
inally by intent, model and host.\n- [Get one run's suite quality-gate report](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get
-one-runs-suite-quality-gate-report.md): ONE run's stored suite quality-gate report (`SuiteGateReportV1`): passed, failed, non_gat
eable, or not_configured.\n- [Enable, repoint, or disable a suite's schedule](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/enab
le-repoint-or-disable-a-suites-schedule.md): A schedule fires exactly ONE run per interval, so an environment-based suite must pin
exactly one of its attached environments. Omitting `environmentId` on a single-environment suite means that environment; omitting
it on a multi-environment suite is a VALIDATION_ERROR. Disabling preserves the exist…\n- [Launch one run per target as a group (a
sync)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/launch-one-run-per-target-as-a-group-async.md): Launches ONE run per target
(attached project environments, or attached named hosts) under a single **server-minted** `runGroupId`, then detaches execution a
nd responds `202` with a per-target receipt.\n- [Create an eval suite (author-only, does not run)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-ref
erence/eval-runs/create-an-eval-suite-author-only-does-not-run.md): Creates a runnable eval suite (the suite record plus its test
cases) and responds `201` **synchronously**, WITHOUT executing anything. Use this to author a suite, then run it later with `POST
/eval-runs` (passing the returned `suiteId`).\n- [Resolve or create a file-owned eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
